events.name: Polluted Factory
events.intro: A fenced-off factory leaking green fog into the grass. Everything in there is grimy, and a foreman is waving a clipboard.

success.text: The gate buzzes open. The air tastes of metal.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Polluted Factory: The Gate
events.intro: A foreman asks you to sign a waiver. It is mostly a drawing of a Grimer wearing a hard hat.

success.text: He nods solemnly and lets you through.
He squints at the name, shrugs, and lets you through.
Clause 9 says the pipes burst. You note the warning.

events.name: Polluted Factory: The Pipes
events.intro: Rusty pipes run overhead. One of them is dripping.

success.text: Nothing bursts. A grimy Pokémon drops down in front of you.

failure.text: A pipe bursts! Poison gas hits your lead, and a grimy Pokémon drops down.

events.name: Polluted Factory: The Vats
events.intro: A worker in a stained coat blocks the stairs. "Unauthorised! Prepare to be decontaminated!"

success.text: He throws a Pokéball with a gloved hand.

events.name: Polluted Factory: The Sludge Trench
events.intro: A trench of green sludge. Three Grimer rise out of it at once.

events.name: Polluted Factory: Control Room (1 of 3)
events.intro: A wall of valves. A note says: "SAFE valves are the ones with a blue ring."

success.text: The valve seals with a clunk.

failure.text: It sticks. The valve is not fully closed.

events.name: Polluted Factory: Control Room (2 of 3)
events.intro: Another bank. The note says: "Never the red ones. Red means the boiler."

success.text: The valve seals with a clunk.

failure.text: It sticks. The valve is not fully closed.

events.name: Polluted Factory: Control Room (3 of 3)
events.intro: The last bank hisses. The note says: "Turn clockwise. Slowly."

success.text: The valve seals with a clunk.

failure.text: It sticks. The valve is not fully closed.

events.name: Polluted Factory: The Furnace
events.intro: The furnace room glows orange. A huge Muk, glowing like embers, slides out of the molten sludge. It is Magmuk, and it will not be caught.

success.text: Molten sludge seeps across the floor!

events.name: Polluted Factory: Rescued
events.intro: With Magmuk gone, three Pokémon come out from behind the machines. One will follow you out.

success.text: Alolan Grimer sticks to your boot and will not let go.
Delta Grimer rolls after you, humming.

events.name: Safari Land
events.intro: A wide gate and a ticket booth. "Welcome to Safari Land! ₽500 gets you 30 Safari Balls and 500 steps. No battling inside." Beyond the fence the grass moves with a huge crowd of Pokémon.

success.text: The warden hands you 30 Safari Balls. Something big stirs in the grass right away.
You watch the herd for a while, then move along.

events.name: Deep Savanna
events.intro: Flat gold grass under a hard sun, and a wall of sand on the horizon. Ground-types move through it like fish.

success.text: The sand wall closes around you.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Deep Savanna: The Plain
events.intro: Dry grass rustles. Something fast is running through it.

success.text: Something bursts out of the dust.

events.name: Deep Savanna: Watering Hole
events.intro: A small pool, ringed with tracks. The water is clean.

events.name: Deep Savanna: Dust Devil
events.intro: A column of sand spins toward you across the plain.

success.text: The dust devil tears across you. Your lead is scoured and slowed.

events.name: Deep Savanna: The Oasis
events.intro: Palm trees ahead and a second watering hole. Something is moving at its edge.

success.text: A Sand Veil Diglett group pops out of the sand, all at once!

failure.text: Just a quiet oasis. You drink and rest.

events.name: Deep Savanna: Dune Duel
events.intro: A Ground-type trainer waits on a high dune. "One duel, then the road is yours."

events.name: Deep Savanna: Sandstorm Camp
events.intro: A ring of tents in the lee of a rock. The storm howls but the camp is warm.

success.text: You strap it onto a Pokémon.
A little Gible with sandpaper skin follows you.
A patient Trapinch climbs out of its pit.

events.name: Lush Jungle
events.intro: Thick green and thicker air. Everything drips, and the vines look like they are watching.

success.text: You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Lush Jungle: Vines
events.intro: Vines hang across the trail.

success.text: The vines catch your lead. A wild Pokémon rustles out of the leaves.

effects.label: Tangled: Speed -15% for the next fight

events.name: Lush Jungle: More Vines
events.intro: The trail narrows. The vines here are thicker.

success.text: Another tangle, and another wild Pokémon.

effects.label: Tangled: Speed -15% for the next fight

events.name: Lush Jungle: Spore Cloud
events.intro: A fat mushroom bursts underfoot and the air turns yellow.

failure.text: Poison spores! Your lead is poisoned.

events.name: Lush Jungle: Hidden Ruin (1 of 2)
events.intro: A mossy wall of carved glyphs. A clue is scratched in the stone: "Not the leaf, not the fang."

success.text: A dart of spores hisses out. Nothing else.

events.name: Lush Jungle: Hidden Ruin (2 of 2)
events.intro: A second wall. "Three then one, and the last is the moon."

success.text: The wall opens on a hidden alcove.

events.name: Lush Jungle: The Alcove
events.intro: Inside the ruin: a faded mural and a small stone dish.

success.text: You work out what the carvers meant. It sharpens your thinking.
You go back to the trail.

events.name: Lush Jungle: The Jungle Chief
events.intro: A tall ranger in leaf-green stands on a root. "This is my jungle. Show me you can keep up."

events.name: Lush Jungle: The Heart
events.intro: The trail ends at a clearing. In the middle, something very large breathes slowly under a blanket of leaves.

success.text: A Venusaur, sleeping at the heart of the jungle. It wakes!

failure.text: Only a heap of leaves, rising and falling with the wind.

events.name: Lush Jungle: Treehouse
events.intro: A rope ladder leads up to a treehouse. There is food, a hammock, and two gifts left out.

success.text: A shaggy Tangela follows you down.
A shy Foongus follows you down.

events.name: Warden's Gold Teeth
events.intro: The Safari Warden is pacing the fence, hand over his mouth. "I lost my gold teeth somewhere in the Zone. Find them and I will make it worth your while."

events.name: Warden's Gold Teeth: The Center
events.intro: The Center of the Zone: wide grass, a bench, and hoofprints everywhere.

success.text: A glint in the grass: the teeth!

failure.text: Nothing here but a chewed bench. On to Area 2.

events.name: Warden's Gold Teeth: Area 2
events.intro: Area 2: tall reeds and a muddy bank.

events.name: Warden's Gold Teeth: Area 3
events.intro: Area 3: the far corner of the Zone, dry and rocky.

success.text: Wedged between two stones: the teeth.

events.name: Warden's Gold Teeth: Thanks
events.intro: The Warden grins a gold-less grin, then slides the teeth back in. "A fine day! Take this."

success.text: He teaches you Strength and gives you a Safari Pass. Your next Safari Land visit starts with 10 extra Safari Balls.

effects.text: Found the Safari Warden's gold teeth.

events.name: Tauros Stampede
events.intro: A rumble in the ground. A herd of Tauros comes over the ridge, straight at you.

success.text: You dive aside. The herd thunders past. Nobody is hurt.

choices.label: Throw bait and hold your ground

success.text: The herd slows, sniffing the bait.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (1 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (2 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (3 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (4 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (5 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: Throw (6 of 6)
events.intro: The herd mills around you.

events.name: Tauros Stampede: The Haul
events.intro: The dust settles. The Tauros you caught wait in a line.

success.text: A big Tauros snorts and falls in beside you.
Each Tauros past the first leaves a charm behind.

events.name: Fuchsia Zoo
events.intro: The Fuchsia Zoo, with pens of rare Pokémon from all over. A keeper is selling a few oddities by the gate.

success.text: The keeper tells you what each type is weak to. You learn a lot.
A Rare Candy changes hands. "Only one a customer," the keeper warns.

events.name: The Snag Test
events.intro: Two Team Snag'em operatives are testing a Snag Machine on a Safari trainer's Pokémon. One has already been snagged mid-battle. The trainer looks panicked.

success.text: The trainer's Rhyhorn charges beside you.

win.text: Took the Snag Ball prototype from Team Snag'em.

success.text: You see how the machine works, then slip away.
